messages:
Ana: Heads up — my flight got delayed and I won't be back for the 10:30 slot. Can we reshuffle today's RFC review order?
Miguel: Do you mean swap the two RFCs entirely or push one to next week?
Ana: Prefer swap if possible. rfc-compiler-opt is shorter and can go earlier without the author, rfc-ops-mem needs author presence. Also want to squeeze the 10m quant-pruning update in between if we can.
Ravi: I'm fine with compiler first. I'm on a call at 10:35 so can present compiler intro by 10:05 then drop.
Jamie: I can flex. Can someone repost the pre-read links?
Ana: Pre-reads: https://redwood.dev/rfc/compiler-opt (updated last night) and https://redwood.dev/rfc/ops-mem. Quant pruning diff: https://github.com/redwood/ops/pull/451 — ~10 lines changed. Please ACK once you skim.
Sarah: ack — skimmed compiler doc, nothing blocking from infra side.
Leo: I'll take the 10m quant-pruning slot if you need me to present.
Miguel: OK locking proposal: 10:00 rfc-compiler-opt (Ana intro, Ravi covers perf bits), 10:20 quant-pruning (Leo, 10m), 10:30 rfc-ops-mem (Ana). If anyone strongly objects speak up now.
Jamie: Works for me. Can someone update the calendar invite and add the two pre-read links in the event?
Ana: I'll update invites and add slides to #rfc-assets channel in ~15m.
ci-bot: Reminder: upload slides to #rfc-assets at least 10m before meeting.
Ana: Thanks — moving invites now. :thumbsup:
